senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (चेष्टते)
To act or perform functions, duties, &c. to strive, to endeavour, to be busy or follow any particular avocation.

f. (-ष्टा)
Effort, exertion, bodily effort.
E.
चेष्ट to act, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Making effort, who or what acts or attempts any act.
n. (-नं)
Effort, exertion.
E.
चेष्ट, and युच् or ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Active, moving.
E.
चेष्ट to exert, शानच् aff.

n. (-णं)
Observing a person's actions.
E.
चेष्टा, and निरूपण investigating.

m. (-शः)
The end of the world.
E.
चेष्टा, and नाश destruction.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Exerted, done with effort.
2 Done.
n. (-तं)
1 Going, motion.
2 Bodily act or function.
3 Action, behaviour.
E.
चेष्ट to act, affix क्त.
